layers: training_features.tif Bands 1-19 (true arctan2(B09,B03) magnetic tilt & arctan2(B11,B18) gravity tilt; B06 reclassified as radiometric TC)

hypotheses.mechanism: Combines depth-invariant magnetic & gravity tilt contact gradients, shallow fault-gouge demagnetization, smectite clay-cap MT breaches, hydrothermal upflow, and 2015-2026 3D ComCat rupture planes under a continuous alluvial-cover gate, coupled out-of-fold with visible fault tip/stepover kinematics and allocated via exact 6-shell Bernoulli tail self-credit DTI optimization.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Un-faulted granitic pluton margins & caldera rings, pluvial Lake Lahontan shorelines & basalt caprock cliffs, GeoDAWN Area 1/2 flight-line seams, and down-fan lateral thermal outflow plumes.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Fixes B06 radiometric TC mislabeling in gems57/geo.py:54; restores 10 omitted competition bands including B09/B11 vertical derivatives; adds verbatim 2015-2026 3D ComCat ruptures; replaces H33's 90%-topography static d_cat>2 collar and gems57's clipped-sum k_self with exact shell-tail submodular DTI allocation.
hypotheses.external_obtainability: 100% public, free, official DOI/API sources verified and SHA-256 pinned locally.

hypotheses.title: Cross-Potential Analytic Signal Ratio & Euler Depth-Step Discontinuity
hypotheses.mechanism: Hanging-wall vs footwall Euler source depth jump across 2D magnetic analytic signal ridges.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Dipping Tertiary sill/dike roofs and paleochannel basalt fills.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Tests asymmetric cross-strike basement depth step rather than symmetric gradient magnitude.

hypotheses.title: Cross-Canyon Fluvial Steepness (k_sn) Step & Chi-Divide Asymmetry Lineaments
hypotheses.mechanism: Strike-coherent positive steps in normalized channel steepness across parallel range-front canyons.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Resistant silicified ash-flow tuff or carbonate beds.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Uses drainage-area-normalized fluvial incision steps across debris-flow-buried fan apices rather than local slope.

hypotheses.title: Topographic Head Back-Projection of Orphan Geothermometer Plumes to MT Barriers
hypotheses.mechanism: Back-projects lateral thermal outflow plumes up hydraulic head gradient to up-dip MT clay-cap edges.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Replaces isotropic radial kernels on well coordinates with anisotropic up-gradient back-projection.

hypotheses.title: Transtensional Strain-Partitioning Regime Index x Declustered Seismicity Fabric
hypotheses.mechanism: Couples geodetic dilation-to-shear ratio with multiscale Hessian ridge orientation of declustered seismicity.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Magmatic inflation in Long Valley-Mono-Aurora borderland and GPS interpolation smoothness.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Combines transtensional strain ratio with directional seismic ridge anisotropy.
